distractors.reason: We don't say 'a good team member' to describe someone who cooperates well. 'Team member' only names someone who belongs to the group.
'Team worker' is not a fixed phrase. 'Worker' describes a job, not a personality trait.
'Team leader' describes someone who directs the group. A 'team player' is someone who works well with others, not necessarily someone in charge.

example_sentence: My sister is a good team ___ because she always helps others.
l1_interference: Osoby mówiące po polsku mogą odwrócić kolejność rzeczowników i powiedzieć 'player team' albo użyć słowa 'member' dosłownie. Pamiętaj, że w angielskim 'team' jest przed 'player'.
explanation: In English, 'team player' is a fixed compound noun. The first noun, 'team', describes the second noun, 'player', and the phrase describes a person who cooperates well with a group.

related_collocations.example: Our team leader organizes the meetings every Monday.
The team spirit in our class is very strong.
Finishing the project was a real team effort.

memory_tip: The first noun describes the second: TEAM PLAYER = a player who belongs to a team; PLAYER TEAM is wrong
